title: Dhua uth raha hai
body:
Haye shame ghareeba'n, ghareebo'n ki shaam
Aseero'n ki shaam, pyaaso'n ki shaam
Shaam e ghareeba'n
<<MINI>>
Jal chuke sadaat ke khaime
<<DIVIDER>>
dhuaa uth raha hai..(2)
<<MINI>>
Jal chuke sadaat ke khaime
<<DIVIDER>>
dhuaa uth raha hai..(2)
1. Ujde gharo ki sham hai, tishna labo ki sham hai
toote dilo'n ki shaam hai..(2)
bujh gaye jitne diye the.. dhuaa uth raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kuch der pehle lootne, zalim yaha'n par aaye the
sabki ridaein le gaye..(2)
reh gaye bus jalte khaime.. dhuaa uth raha hai
3. Masnad jali, jhula jala, bistar bhi abid ka jala
<<DIVIDER>>
khaimo mein aur kya kya jala..(2)
aaj phir zehra ke ghar se.. dhuaa uth raha hai
4. Layi bachakar tishna kaam, sholo ki zadd par the imam
zainab ki himmat ko salam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
bistare zainul iba se.. dhuaa uth raha hai
5. Parda nashee'n hai khak basar, chote bade hai nauhagar
chup hai sakina kyu magar..(2)
is yateema ke hi dil se.. dhuaa uth raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Har suu udasi chha gayi, aale nabi ghabra gayi
pehre pe zainab aa gayi..(2)
dekhlo abbas aake.. dhuaa uth raha hai
7. Hatho'n mein lekar haziri, jab hurr ki zawja aayi thi
<<DIVIDER>>
sar peet kar kehne lagi..(2)
hogayi takheer mujhse.. dhuaa uth raha hai
8. Baba se zainab ne kaha, ab aaye ho mushkil kusha
jab mera sab kuch lut gaya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhlo khaimo se mere.. dhuaa uth raha hai
9. Farhan o Mazhar abidi, daswi ki shab dhalti rahi
aale nabi roti rahi..(2)
marsiya zainab ka sunke.. dhuaa uth raha hai
